Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and two asks so we can finalize the pilot pricing: 

What we discussed
- Pilot workload: user-facing summarization + search re-ranking (~2.3k avg tokens/session).
- Expected call volume: 40k sessions/month initially, scaling to ~150k over 3 months.
- Success metric: <120ms 95p latency and median cost < $4.5 / 1M tokens for the production path.

Two quick asks to get a firm quote and procurement path:
1) Can you confirm the monthly budget corridor you expect to approve (range is fine — e.g., $15k–$45k / month)?
2) What procurement/PO threshold will trigger finance involvement (e.g., >$25k/month or annual contract)?

If you prefer, we can propose two pricing/commit options once we have those numbers: a low-commit pilot (no PO, monthly pay-as-you-go) and a reserved buffer (3–6 month commit with discounted $/1M token).

I attached a short procurement checklist that other customers find helpful. I copied Marissa so she can prep the quote once you confirm the envelope + PO trigger.

Thanks — talk soon,

Hi Marcus — great demo. Quick answers below: 

Budget corridor:
- We can sign off on pilots up to $30k/month without VP level approval.
- Anything above $30k/month will need approval from our VP of Product and Procurement (likely a 2–3 week review).

PO/Procurement threshold:
- Procurement requires a PO for any vendor with expected spend > $50k total over a 12-month period. For monthly billing, that effectively means PO if we expect > $4.2k/month over 12 months but in practice they look at annual commitment.

Preferred cadence:
- For initial pilot we prefer a short reserved buffer (1 month commit) if the unit economics are clear; otherwise pay-as-you-go is okay.

Elena

elena@orchard.ai

Option A — Low-commit pilot (preferred to iterate fast)- Pricing: Pay-as-you-go blended at $9.50 / 1M input+output tokens- Estimated monthly spend (40k sessions): ~$18k/month- Pros: No PO required for short term, fast start- Cons: Higher $/1M tokens, potential cost variance

Option B — 3-month reserved buffer (recommended if you want predictability)- Pricing: Discounted $6.75 / 1M tokens with minimum monthly commit of $25k- Estimated monthly spend (40k sessions): $13.5k (meets commit)- Pros: Lower unit cost, predictable billing and lower latency SLOs due to reserved capacity- Cons: Requires internal sign-off if commit >$30k/month

Important notes and next steps:
- If your procurement treats the 3-month commit as part of an annual obligation, that may trigger the PO process you described.
- We can structure the quote so the first month is refundable if you pivot after the pilot — helps reduce procurement friction.

Request: please confirm whether the $30k/mo approval boundary you mentioned is a hard veto (i.e., VP sign-off required) or if it can be escalated within your procurement team with a short justification. Once you confirm, Marissa will finalize the attached quote (quote-ORCH-4721.xlsx) and I’ll include a DocuSign flow.
